_comment: Golden reference values for the de Winter 2008 implementation (docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_DEWINTER_2008.md, validation matrix V3/V4). Sources: analytic mass balance (AUC = MPA dose/CL for 12h-periodic absorption; 24h sum for EC-MPS whose absorption is 24h-periodic), the analytic IV bi-exponential, and grid-converged engine values (96-point grid, typical parameters, wt 70). MMF 1000 mg = 739 mg MPA; EC-MPS 720 mg = 674 mg MPA (x0.739 / x0.936).

ecmps720MorningAUC12.note: morning-dose-anchored window; the 30-60 target refers to morning profiles

ecmps720EveningAUC12.note: evening-dose-anchored window; delayed evening absorption lands at clock ~05:00

ecmps24hBalance.note: morning + evening windows = 2 x dose/CL (exact invariant for 24h-periodic absorption)
